rule: A foreign providerEventId in a settlement-join file for gamePk G is aliased to G only when the provider's own record (teams + commence time) is known and consistent, the id is not another game's own event, G is on that date's StatsAPI board with no other game between the same clubs and no second provider start for them that day (no doubleheader), the event matches exactly G with the same home and away clubs and a scheduled start within 30 minutes, every join file holding the id agrees, and the provider's own daily event listing for that date independently lists the exact id with the same clubs and start. Everything else is refused. No archive row is edited or re-joined.
